HW7 Question 1(c)
=================

Monetary shock series used: resid_romer
Sample ends at 2007Q4.
Fernald data are interpreted as annualized quarterly growth rates:
dlog(TFP) = dtfp / 400
dlog(utilization-adjusted TFP) = dtfp_util / 400
Then they are cumulated into log levels.

Sample range for TFP regressions:
Start: 1969 Q1 
End:   2007 Q4 
N:     156
